description.zh: Victor42 自研的 AI Agent 能力包。每个 skill 是一组结构化指令，安装后你的 Agent 在特定场景下会自动调用。用 skills CLI 一键安装，或打开详情页复制命令。
description.en: Capability packs for AI agents by Victor42. Each skill is a structured instruction set your agent loads for specific tasks. Install with the skills CLI, or copy the command from a detail page.

summary.zh: 多轮任务跨 Agent 工具切换时的上下文交接包。只保留下一棒 Agent 继续推进所需的最小信息；开箱写成本机目录，接上对象存储后可跨机器取。
summary.en: Minimal context packages for switching AI tools mid-task. Keeps only what the next agent needs — on disk by default, in your own bucket once you connect one.

zh.heading: 它做什么
items: 换到另一个 AI 工具时，生成一份临时交接包（通常只有一份 notes.md）
只回答一个问题：下一棒要继续推进，还缺什么
典型场景：任务做到一半要换工具——目标、改过哪些文件、验证过的命令、下一步与红线，一次交代清楚，不必从头复述
脚本、结构化数据、长日志才单独成文件

zh.heading: 交接包里有什么
items: Goal / Context / Current State（已完成 · 已验证 · 待办）/ Handoff Notes
只保留继续推进所必需的路径、决策与约束
接手方做完全部待办后删掉整个包；够不到位置时由你删

zh.heading: 两种交接通道
items: 本地目录：开箱即用，写成本机 handoff-<主题>/，不依赖网络与凭据
对象存储：一次性配好桶、token 与 config 之后，跨机器、跨工具都能取
云端没配置就不问、直接本地；配置了但不通才问你选本地还是修云端，不静默降级

zh.heading: 何时触发
items: 你明确说「交接」「handoff」「换 Agent」「我要换工具继续」
多轮任务中途要换工具，又不想丢上下文
你接手别人的交接包：按包内待办推进，做完负责删包

en.heading: What it does
items: Builds a temporary handoff package (usually a single notes.md) when you switch AI tools
Answers one question: what does the next agent need to keep going
Typical case: a task half done in one tool, picked up in another — goal, files changed, commands verified, next steps and red lines stated once instead of re-explained
Scripts, structured data or long logs get separate files

en.heading: What's in the package
items: Goal / Context / Current State (done · verified · open) / Handoff Notes
Only the paths, decisions and constraints needed to continue
The receiving agent deletes the whole package once every open item is done; you delete it if it can't reach the location

en.heading: Two channels
items: Local directory: works out of the box, writes handoff-<theme>/ on this machine, no network or credentials
Object storage: after a one-time bucket, token and config setup, packages cross machines and tools
Unconfigured cloud never asks and goes local; only a configured-but-unreachable cloud asks local-or-fix — no silent downgrade

en.heading: When it triggers
items: You explicitly ask for a handoff / agent switch / tool transfer
A multi-turn task needs to survive switching AI tools
You receive someone's handoff package: work its open items, then delete it

summary.zh: CLI 工具集：图片格式转换、缩放、去重、GIF 合成、音视频转换、公众号文章视频下载、文件夹扁平化等批量文件操作。
summary.en: CLI toolkit for format conversion, resize, dedup, GIF compose, audio/video convert, WeChat article video download, and bulk file operations.

zh.heading: 图片
items: 格式互转：jpg / png / webp / avif / gif / bmp / tiff
Resize：指定宽高，裁剪或填充
缩放：设定最大边长，保持比例
裁头像：自动检测人脸，输出圆形或方形
去重：感知哈希识别相似图
GIF：多帧合成 / GIF 拆成帧序列

zh.heading: 音视频
items: 音频互转：mp3 / wav / flac / aac / ogg / m4a / opus
视频互转：mp4 / avi / mov / mkv / webm 等
从视频提取音轨
多张图片合成视频，支持交叉淡入淡出

zh.heading: 下载
items: 下载微信公众号文章内嵌视频，按视频标题命名，可选最高清或全部清晰度

zh.heading: 文件管理
items: 嵌套文件夹一键扁平化
按 CSV 批量重命名
支持单文件与整文件夹批量处理

en.heading: Images
items: Convert among jpg / png / webp / avif / gif / bmp / tiff
Resize with crop or pad modes
Scale by max edge while keeping aspect ratio
Avatar crop with face detection (circle or square)
Dedup via perceptual hash
Compose GIF from frames / explode GIF to frames

en.heading: Audio & video
items: Convert audio: mp3 / wav / flac / aac / ogg / m4a / opus
Convert video: mp4 / avi / mov / mkv / webm, and more
Extract audio tracks from video
Images → video with optional crossfade

en.heading: Download
items: Download videos embedded in WeChat articles, named by video title, best-quality or all resolutions

en.heading: Files
items: Flatten nested folders in one pass
Batch rename from CSV
Works on single files or whole folders

summary.zh: 把「查航班、查火车、查天气、找地点」变成能直接回答的问题。数据来自高德、飞常准、携程与 Open-Meteo，附已校验过的查询规则，避免 Agent 编出假航班号。只给数据与顺序，不排行程。
summary.en: Turns “which flight, which train, what weather, where exactly” into answers. Data from Amap, Variflight, Ctrip and Open-Meteo, with verified query rules that keep the agent from inventing flight numbers. Data and order only, no itinerary.

zh.heading: 能帮你问什么
items: 「明天杭州飞成都还有票吗，最早一班几点」→ 班次、时刻、票价区间
「周六上海到南京的高铁，下午两点后还有座吗」→ 车次、历时、余票、票价
「下周三丽江会下雨吗」「去年十月大理什么天气」→ 未来预报、历史同期
「西湖到灵隐寺多远，开车要多久」→ 坐标、周边地点、驾车/步行/公交路线

zh.heading: 数据从哪来
items: 高德：地址与坐标、周边地点、路线、天气、地图
飞常准：航班计划、中转方案、票价
携程：车次、历时、余票、票价
Open-Meteo：天气预报、历史天气
高德与飞常准需要自备 Key（高德控制台申请，飞常准的申请指引随包附带）；携程与 Open-Meteo 开箱即用

zh.heading: 它不做什么
items: 不排行程：给数据与规划顺序，不给景点筛选与小时级日程
不抓大众点评 / 小红书：无公开 API，风控严格
不给结论：数据可以给全，取舍由人定

zh.heading: 为什么答案靠得住
items: 四类数据都附实测校验：景点坐标必须按地名检索，航班与中转要用不同的三字码，航班列表要自行按时刻排序，报错提示可能指向一个服务端根本不读的请求头
这些规则写在 skill 本体里，Agent 每次调用都照此执行

en.heading: What you can ask
items: “Any seats on tomorrow's Hangzhou–Chengdu flight, and when is the first one?” → schedules, times, fare ranges
“Shanghai–Nanjing high-speed trains on Saturday after 2pm — any seats?” → services, duration, availability, fares
“Will it rain in Lijiang next Wednesday?” “What was Dali like last October?” → forecast, same period in past years
“How far is Lingyin Temple from West Lake, and how long by car?” → coordinates, nearby places, driving/walking/transit routes

en.heading: Where the data comes from
items: Amap: addresses and coordinates, nearby places, routes, weather, map tiles
Variflight: flight schedules, transfers, fares
Ctrip: services, duration, availability, fares
Open-Meteo: forecast, historical weather
Amap and Variflight need your own key (Amap console; a Variflight application guide ships with the skill); Ctrip and Open-Meteo work as-is

en.heading: What it doesn't do
items: No itinerary: data and planning order only — no attraction shortlisting, no hour-level schedule
No scraping Dianping / Xiaohongshu: no public API, strict anti-bot
No verdicts: data can be complete, the trade-offs stay with you

en.heading: Why the answers hold up
items: All four sources ship verified rules: attraction coordinates need a place-name search, flights and transfers use different three-letter codes, flight lists must be sorted by time, and error text can point at a header the server never reads
Those rules live in the skill itself, so the agent follows them on every call

summary.zh: 古典诗词深度解读方法：从时代、作者、地理、文学性、传统、接受史六个维度立体读一首诗。
summary.en: In-depth classical Chinese poetry interpretation from six lenses: era, author, geography, craft, tradition, and reception history.

zh.heading: 六维读法
items: 【世】时代背景：这首诗何以在此刻写成
【人】作者生平：诗人的处境与意图
【地】地理：地名、空间与意象如何落地
【统】文学传统：它继承或改写了什么
【受】接受史：后人如何读它、为什么传下来
【文】作品本体：技艺与结构——它为何是艺术

zh.heading: 产出形态
items: 出版级深度解读，而非一行翻译或浅层赏析
先写六合草稿，再收敛创作前时间线，最后合成可读文本
服务对象：有好奇心、无专业文学素养的深度读者

zh.heading: 适用与否
items: 适用：古典诗歌历史名篇（作者、系年、接受史有据可查）
不适用：简单翻译、现代自由诗、作者不可考或信息极度稀薄的篇目

en.heading: Six lenses
items: Era: why this poem was written in this moment
Author: the poet's situation and intent
Geography: places, space, and how imagery lands
Tradition: what it inherits or rewrites
Reception: how later readers shaped its afterlife
Craft: structure and technique — why it is art

en.heading: What you get
items: Publication-grade interpretation, not a one-line gloss
Draft across six lenses → converge pre-composition timeline → readable synthesis
For curious deep readers without specialist literary training

en.heading: Fit
items: Best for well-documented classical poems
Not for simple translation, modern free verse, or barely attested texts

summary.zh: 用短促的苏格拉底对话推动思考，同时在侧边维护一份持续生长、无损展开的认知框架。
summary.en: Build a living cognitive model beside concise Socratic dialogue, expanding ideas in place without losing confirmed detail.

zh.heading: 双表面共建
items: 聊天保持短促、具体，每轮最多推进一个因果问题
Living Surface 承载完整模型，随对话原位展开而不是记录流水账
适配原生侧边文档、本地 Markdown 与云端远程文档三类环境

zh.heading: 认知方法
items: 先锁定使用者、目标、场景与现实约束，再构建框架
从微观现象切入，向下寻找第一性原理底座并标记跨层因果
保留可证伪假设、反例、具体案例与所有已确认细节

zh.heading: 适用与边界
items: 适用：明确要求认知塑形或多轮共建持续生长的认知模型
不适用：普通解释、一次性分析、翻译或内容发布
云端默认使用 secret Gist；它仅未公开列出，并非私密存储，失败时回退为聊天全文

en.heading: Two coordinated surfaces
items: Keeps chat concise and concrete, advancing at most one causal question per turn
Maintains the full model in a Living Surface that expands in place instead of becoming a transcript
Adapts to native side documents, local Markdown, and remote cloud documents

en.heading: Cognitive method
items: Locks the user, goal, scene, and real constraints before building the framework
Enters through a micro-phenomenon, then finds first-principles bedrock and cross-layer causality
Preserves falsifiable hypotheses, counterexamples, concrete cases, and every confirmed detail

en.heading: Fit and boundaries
items: Use for explicit Cognition Shaper requests or multi-turn co-building of a living cognitive model
Not for ordinary explanations, one-shot analysis, translation, or publishing
Cloud mode defaults to a secret Gist; it is unlisted, not private, with full-document chat fallback
